acceptanceCriteria: gate-ledger keys a declared package by its subtree plus declared entries (and the declaration file) instead of the whole tree, reading the same grammar as tools/gate-affected-select.
A test shows an unrelated tree change keeps a declared package's ledger record valid and a change under a declared entry invalidates it.
body:
AFP-V0-023 (V1-0246) declares bounded repository reads for root-locating Go test packages. make gate-ledger -unresolved/-bounds still treat those packages as whole-tree readers, so a declared package reruns on any tree change. Found 2026-10-01 while delivering V1-0246.

2026-10-01 (PR438): TestGoTestKeysResolvedPackagesPerPackage copies a hand-maintained list of gate-ledger source files (main.go, readers.go) into its fixture; adding readscopes.go broke it in hosted CI until the list was extended (d22fbe14). Honouring the scopes here will touch the same fixture; consider deriving the copied file set from the package rather than a literal list.

completion.reason: Already delivered on origin/main by 564f4e81a2835384fc9facbd1f2e4515e15f5137; each acceptance criterion checked against the commit's focused test and spec change in the V1-2254 closeout audit 2026-10-21.

title: gate-ledger: honor declared test read scopes in -unresolved and -bounds
